mapper.insert: insert into course_notice(course_id, writer_id, title, content, is_fixed) values(#{dto.courseId}, #{dto.writerId}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.content}, #{dto.isFixed})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_fixed = #{isFixed}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cn.id, cn.course_id, c.name AS courseName, cn.title, cn.content, cn.read_count, cn.is_fixed, cn.created_at, cn.updated_at, u.id AS writerId, u.fullname AS writerName, u.type AS writerType FROM course_notice cn JOIN user u ON cn.writer_id = u.id JOIN course c ON cn.course_id = c.id WHERE cn.id = #{id} AND cn.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, original_name AS originalName, new_name AS newName, path, is_image AS isImage, size FROM file WHERE table_name = 'course_notice' AND table_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(id) FROM course_notice WHERE is_fixed = true AND course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
